zh: 靠广告赚钱的Meta
en: Meta, which makes money from ads,

zh: 开始让AI替人挑选商家了
en: now lets AI choose businesses for people.

zh: 那么以后顾客都是先问AI
en: So, customers will ask AI first.

zh: 那么你的生意还能不能被找得到
en: Then, will your business still be found?

zh: 咱们本地老板除了把店拍得好看以外
en: Local business owners, besides making your shop look good,

zh: 也得让人得查得到
en: you also need to let people find it.

zh: 你能提供什么服务什么条件能接
en: What services can you provide, and on what terms?

zh: 预约从哪里进
en: Where can they make a booking?

zh: AI帮顾客挑选的时候都需要这些条件
en: AI needs these conditions when choosing for customers.

zh: Meta就是Facebook背后的这个公司
en: Meta is the company behind Facebook.

zh: 它有社交平台他有庞大的这个广告生意
en: It has social platforms and a large advertising business.

zh: 今年二季度呢收入差不多98%呢
en: In the second quarter this year, nearly 98% of revenue

zh: 是来自于这个广告
en: came from advertising.

zh: 他的平均这个上线人数大概在30多亿人
en: Its average number of online users is over three billion.

zh: 那么他现在推出这个个人AI助理Muse
en: It has now introduced the personal AI assistant Muse.

zh: 这一步就是想把顾客有需求以后的事接进来
en: This step aims to take over what follows a customer’s need.

zh: 以前呢就是你刷到广告啊就是自己去挑
en: Before, you saw an ad and chose for yourself.

zh: 以后呢你可以直接交代你需要什么你帮我去找
en: Now, you can tell it: “This is what I need. Find it for me.”

zh: 最近大家都说这个PA啊其实就是个人的AI助理
en: The PA people talk about is a personal AI assistant.

zh: Muse有自己的云端浏览器
en: Muse has its own cloud browser.

zh: 能查资料操作网站填表
en: It can look things up, operate websites, and fill in forms.

zh: 买东西之前让客户去确认
en: Before buying, it asks the customer to confirm.

zh: 那这会怎样影响到咱们的生意
en: How will this affect our businesses?

zh: 拿这个兰州订房取个例子
en: Take booking a room in Lanzhou as an example.

zh: 假如说你周末带着家人过来开两间房
en: Suppose your family comes for the weekend and books two rooms.

zh: 开着车晚上十点才能到
en: You are driving and will not arrive until ten at night.

zh: 那么你把这些要求告诉了AI助理然后再加一句话
en: You tell the AI assistant your needs and add one thing:

zh: 行程还不确定取消怎么收费也帮我看清楚
en: “My plans are uncertain. Check the cancellation charges too.”

zh: 以前只搜兰州酒店会出来很多的这些选择
en: Searching “Lanzhou hotels” used to bring up many choices.

zh: 可现在呢你把这些条件放进去之后有些就不适合
en: Now, once these conditions are added, some are unsuitable.

zh: 那么助理要做的就是帮你把这些差别找出来之后
en: The assistant’s job is to find those differences for you,

zh: 让你不会一家一家的去问一遍
en: so you do not have to ask every hotel one by one.

zh: 如果你允许啊他记住你上次交代过的这些偏好
en: If you allow it to remember your previous preferences,

zh: 比如说带老人出门希望有电梯少走路
en: such as needing a lift and less walking with an older person,

zh: 下次呢还可以把这些条件一起进行考虑
en: next time, it can consider those conditions together.

zh: 日期人数预算变了这些他都会跟你再去确认
en: If dates, numbers, or budget change, it confirms them again.

zh: 同样是订房他了解的情况越具体
en: For the same room booking, the more specific the information,

zh: 才越有可能帮你挑到你合适的房子
en: the more likely it is to find a room that suits you.

zh: 挑好了呢还得查当天有没有房
en: After choosing, it still has to check room availability.

zh: 确定价格和退订规则
en: Confirm the price and the cancellation rules.

zh: 你只要一点头他就会继续帮你
en: Once you agree, it will continue helping you.

zh: 推荐一家店跟订成这一单中间的事情
en: Between recommending a shop and completing that booking,

zh: 他一件都不会落下
en: it will not miss a single step.

zh: 对于开店的老板来说
en: For business owners,

zh: 就是这些变化就已经很直接了
en: these changes are already very direct.

zh: 以前你想让顾客多看你一眼
en: Before, to make customers notice you,

zh: 你要研究各个这个平台上的位置
en: You studied positions on various platforms,

zh: 视频和推荐
en: videos, and recommendations.

zh: 以后有些顾客可能只看到AI筛选出来的几家
en: Later, some customers may see only the few options AI selects.

zh: 如果根本没进这个名单
en: If you are not on that list at all,

zh: 就是你那个视频拍的再好这个顾客也未必看得到
en: however good your video is, that customer may never see it.

zh: 所以平台现在最先受到挑战的可能就是这一步
en: This may be the first challenge platforms face:

zh: 顾客还会不会打开慢慢的去挑了
en: will customers still open them and choose slowly?

zh: 但酒店的房态
en: But hotel room availability,

zh: 商家的商品订单和退款还得有人管
en: goods, orders, and refunds still need managing.

zh: 顾客不打开平台交易呢可能仍然会经过它
en: Even without opening the platform, a transaction may use it.

zh: 平台呢不会轻易的把这些积累的东西让出去
en: Platforms will not easily give up what they have accumulated.

zh: 所以呢就是说平台原来的入口优势
en: So, the platform’s original entry-point advantage

zh: 可能会松动啊
en: may weaken.

zh: 但是商家的商品售后这些能力
en: But merchants, goods, and after-sales capabilities

zh: 仍然会参与到竞争
en: still take part in the competition.

zh: 9月21日
en: On September 21,

zh: Meta的股价涨了约11%
en: Meta’s stock rose by about 11%.

zh: 扎克伯格呢也希望未来会从这个AI助理里面
en: Zuckerberg also hopes that, in the future, the AI assistant

zh: 促成交易之后收取它的费用
en: will collect fees after facilitating transactions.

zh: 目前呢国内啊也在往这个方向去做
en: Domestic companies are moving in this direction too.

zh: 但是只是走法可能有点不一样
en: But their approaches may be a little different.

zh: 最近呢咱们这个豆包的二代手机
en: Recently, the second-generation Doubao phone

zh: 就是把AI助理放进了手机系统
en: put the AI assistant into the phone’s operating system,

zh: 让AI尝试跨应用办事
en: letting AI try to handle tasks across apps.

zh: 千问呢
en: Qwen, meanwhile,

zh: 则是把已经接上的这个阿里的服务
en: connects to Alibaba services already linked up.

zh: 你比如说像淘宝闪购飞猪高德这些全部接进来
en: For example, Taobao Instant Commerce, Fliggy, and Amap.

zh: 后来呢他又把这个淘宝互通了
en: Later, it also interconnected with Taobao,

zh: 连着商品订单物流和售后
en: linking goods, orders, logistics, and after-sales service.

zh: 豆包就是从手机里替你操作
en: Doubao operates for you from inside the phone.

zh: 另一家呢就是把自己已有的这个生意呢
en: The other brings its existing business

zh: 接进对话
en: into the conversation.

zh: 千问背后的这些商家商品交易服务
en: Behind Qwen are merchants, goods, and transaction services,

zh: 还有平台原有所有的东西拿出来
en: as well as everything the platform already has.

zh: 这个呢就是提醒我们本地企业做AI应用
en: This reminds us: local businesses implementing AI

zh: 不能光盯着模型会说什么
en: cannot focus only on what the model can say.

zh: 他能够查到哪些业务信息
en: What business information can it find?

zh: 能连接到哪项服务
en: Which service can it connect to?

zh: 遇到办不了的事由谁来接口这些都要看
en: When it cannot finish a task, who provides the interface?

zh: 回到刚才兰州订房的这个客户
en: Back to that customer booking a room in Lanzhou.

zh: 假如你家的这个酒店有停车有电梯
en: Suppose your hotel has parking and a lift,

zh: 也能晚入住啊本来就是很适合的
en: and allows late check-in; it would be a good fit.

zh: 可是网上你只写了环境好服务周到
en: But online, you only wrote “nice environment, attentive service.”

zh: 那么这些条件没有写
en: These conditions were not written down.

zh: AI助理就可能把你录取
en: The AI assistant may select you.

zh: 你开了这么多年店顾客常问什么
en: After years in business, what do customers often ask?

zh: 你其实最清楚
en: You know best.

zh: 就是免费停车还是收费
en: Is parking free, or is there a charge?

zh: 晚上几点以后需要提前联系
en: After what time should they contact you in advance?

zh: 什么情况下不能退
en: Under what conditions is a refund unavailable?

zh: 这些答案就是可能一直有你的前台
en: These answers may have been handled by your front desk,

zh: 一遍一遍的解释
en: explained over and over,

zh: 却没有整理到现在能够被查到的地方
en: but not organized somewhere searchable.

zh: 遇到这种情况呢
en: In that situation,

zh: 我会先和老板们一起把现有的介绍
en: I first review the introduction with business owners.

zh: 和这些常见的问题先过一遍
en: and go over these common questions.

zh: 哪些没有写哪些已经过时了
en: What is missing, and what is already out of date?

zh: 几个地方写的不一样的
en: What is inconsistent across different places?

zh: 以实际的能够提供的服务为准我们把它改清楚
en: We clarify it based on the services actually available.

zh: 我做的项目呢就是会从这些真实的信息入手
en: My projects start from this real information,

zh: 让AI能够查得到也尽量的理解准确
en: so AI can find it and understand it as accurately as possible.

zh: 至于他最后会不会推荐不能光靠我们自己说了算
en: Whether it recommends you is not for us alone to decide.

zh: 要实际的查到他怎么回答的依据是从哪里来的
en: We must check its answers and where the evidence comes from.

zh: 假设AI已经推荐了你
en: Suppose AI has already recommended you.

zh: 那顾客点进来却找不到
en: The customer clicks through but cannot find

zh: 这个预约的入口或者是电话打不通
en: the booking entry, or the phone does not connect.

zh: 这个时候呢你就是再多发一篇介绍
en: At that point, posting another introduction

zh: 也补不上这一步
en: will not fix this step.

zh: 所以我要和老板看的就是
en: What I want to check with owners is

zh: 在这条路上到底断在了哪里
en: where this route has actually broken.

zh: 哪些资料缺了
en: Which information is missing?

zh: 我们能不能把这些预约的页面打开
en: Can we get these booking pages to open?

zh: 就是当天还有没有房需要前台确认
en: Room availability requires front-desk confirmation.

zh: 有人把这些接线
en: Someone makes these connections.

zh: 已有的平台我们就是能用的功能先用
en: Use the existing platform features that are available first.

zh: 不必说把这些所有的再另建一套
en: There is no need to build all of it again separately.

zh: 老板知道哪些条件能答应客户
en: Owners know which terms they can promise customers.

zh: 我先把这些资料和工具整理到员工能用的程度
en: I first organize the information and tools so staff can use them.

zh: 在一起我们检查结果
en: Then, together, we check the results.

zh: 咱们本地能够面对面的看这些业务
en: Here locally, we can review business face to face.

zh: 就把这些便利的条件咱们利用好
en: Let us use these convenient conditions.

zh: 你可以先拿店里的一项服务
en: Start with one service from your shop.

zh: 问AI,看他把地址服务条件说对了没有
en: Ask AI whether it got the address and service terms right.

zh: 给的联系方式和预约的方式能不能用
en: Can the contact and booking methods it gives actually work?

zh: 回答里面有出处的也点进去核对一下
en: If the answer cites a source, open it and check it too.

zh: 这样至少能看见就是顾客能够查到
en: At least you can see what customers can find,

zh: 你跟店里的实际情况到底差在哪里
en: and how you differ from the shop’s actual situation.

zh: 甘肃本地的老板想要做这个企业AI应用的
en: Gansu business owners wanting enterprise AI applications,

zh: GEO的,可以带着你自己的这项服务
en: or GEO, can bring one of your own services,

zh: 我们一起来聊一聊
en: and we can talk it through together.

zh: 就咱们从顾客会问什么
en: Let us start with what customers will ask,

zh: 现在查到了什么,一起往下去看
en: and what they find now, and work through it.

zh: 我是超哥
en: I am Chao Ge,

zh: 在兰州做企业AI应用落地
en: implementing enterprise AI in Lanzhou.
